description:
A themeable desktop system monitor inspired by Conky SeaMod.

ToeRings is a lightweight, themeable desktop system monitor built with Tauri and inspired by the Conky SeaMod theme.
Download the bundle for your platform from the assets below.
Windows releases include an NSIS installer and a portable ZIP for package managers such as Scoop. The Windows binaries are not code-signed, so Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may show a warning.
macOS builds are ad-hoc signed but cannot be notarized without a paid Apple Developer Program membership. On first launch, Control-click ToeRings and choose Open. See the README for additional Gatekeeper instructions.
